Description.Name: Build it, and they will Tremble!
Description.Details:
You find [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] waiting for you outside the MechBay, barely containing {SCN_MW.Det} excitement.

"Commander! It's finished. The Lutefisk Launcher is finally complete!"

You raise an eyebrow. "Already?"

{SCN_MW.Callsign} nods enthusiastically. "Four weeks of work, countless hours in the machine shop, and more modifications than I care to count. But it works." {SCN_MW.Subj_C} gestures toward the MechBay. "The final design is a twenty-five-tube mortar system weighing thirteen tons. It can occupy either the Left or Right Torso of a BattleMech, depending on the Mech's mounting configuration."

 "And the range?"

{SCN_MW.Callsign} grins. "Eight hundred and forty metres. Enough range to put the enemy under pressure without having to get dangerously close." {SCN_MW.Subj_C} pauses dramatically. "And then there's the ammunition."

You sigh. "The lutefisk."

"The lutefisk!" {SCN_MW.Callsign} looks delighted. "We have two custom ammunition types. Lutefisk Ammo is an acidic mortar round designed to spread its corrosive payload over the target area. Lutefisk Smokey Ammo uses the Smoker residue to create an obscuring effect when the round detonates, interfering with enemy sensors and reducing their ability to see what's happening around them."

You stare at {SCN_MW.Obj}. "You built a thirteen-ton, twenty-five-tube mortar launcher so you could fire acidic lutefisk and sensor-obscuring lutefisk at the OpFor?"

{SCN_MW.Callsign} smiles proudly."Precisely, Commander." {SCN_MW.Subj_C} gestures toward the MechBay.

"Come and see it."

Description.Name: Reap the Rewards
Description.Details:
The MechBay doors slide open, and [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] rushes in to stand proudly beside a massive assembly suspended from a mounting hoist. The finished Lutefisk Launcher hangs several meters above the deck, secured by heavy restraints and surrounded by cables, lifting equipment, and installation gear.

Twenty-five mortar tubes are arranged into a compact firing array, their mechanisms and feed systems integrated into the thirteen-ton weapon system.

{SCN_MW.Callsign} gestures toward the suspended launcher. "Twenty-five tubes, Commander. Thirteen tons. It can occupy either the Left or Right Torso of a suitable 'Mech. Maximum range is eight hundred and forty meters."

{SCN_MW.Subj_C} pauses, clearly pleased with himself.

"And it is ready. Once we find the right 'Mech, the astechs can install it directly into the torso."

You look over the imposing weapon system, remembering how this project began with a goat, a strange recipe, and a crate of lutefisk.

{SCN_MW.Callsign} can't stop grinning. "Soon, Commander. Soon we will make the enemy taste the finest JàrnFòlk engineering."
